reason: A DSH Web interface plugin that replaces eligible browser context menus with extensible actions and adds a workspace-sidebar action to open a folder in the host file manager.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供可扩展的自定义右键菜单，并支持从工作区侧边栏打开对应文件夹。
summaries.en: Adds an extensible custom context menu to DSH Web and lets users open workspace folders from the sidebar in the host file manager.

capabilities: Intercepts browser context-menu events outside editable elements
Provides a provider registration API for custom menu items
Matches workspace entries and requests opening their folders in the host file manager
Invokes platform-specific file-manager commands after directory validation
